scholarships.name: Combined study and practical stays for engineers from developing countries (KOSPIE) with Colombian universities **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: Advanced students of engineering from one of ten Colombian universities that are parties to the agreement initially spend one semester at a German university and then complete a 4 to 6-month industrial internship.
scholarships.sourceQuote: Advanced students of engineering from the following participating universities: Escuela Colombiana de Ingenieria Julio Garavito, Bogotá Universidad del Valle, Cali Universidad Santo Tomás, Bogotá Universidad del Norte, Barranquilla Pontificia Universidad Javeriana, Cali Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Bogotá
